title: Consumption clarity: session-merge entropy normalizer for multi-route token attribution
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Problem: Token accounting currently double-counts or misattributes tokens for requests that span multi-route forks (stream+batch fallback, tool-calling with separate routes) and for late-arriving usage events coming from sidecar shippers. This causes noisy invoices and automated chargeback errors for Dedicated customers.

Goal: Implement a deterministic session-merge and entropy-normalization layer in the analytics pipeline that: 1) deduplicates tokens from multi-route/replicated records using a stable fingerprint, 2) applies a configurable dedupe window and confidence score to late-arrivals, and 3) exposes audit fields to the Console to explain attribution decisions. The feature must handle 200k events/s with <5s added latency to downstream metering and preserve existing billing SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline produces a single canonical token record per customer request in >99.95% of sampled cases (measured on 48h rollup)
Late-arrival events (<7 days) are merged with original session and assigned a confidence score; confidence <0.4 flags review without changing invoice totals
Console exposes `canonical_session_id`, `fingerprint_reason`, and `dedupe_confidence` fields in per-request logs and the route-level billing table
End-to-end ingestion latency increase <5s p95 for production data volume
Unit and integration tests cover fingerprint collisions, ordering inversion, and time-bucket watermark handling
tasks: Design fingerprinting strategy (session + route + seed) and collision bounds
Prototype streaming dedupe operator in Flink/Beam job `session_merge_v2`
Add watermarking and late-arrival logic with configurable window (default 10m, policy opts up to 7d)
Integrate dedupe outcome into metering ledger writer with idempotent upserts
Add audit columns to metering stores and Console API surface
Performance tests and chaos run against production-like trace samples
Create migration for existing unresolved duplicates (backfill job)
implementation_notes: Use xxhash64 over (customer_id || request_id || route_hash || trace_parent) with a salt from tenant config to reduce cross-tenant collision risk
Fingerprint must be stable across minor route rewrites; include model signature and quantization_profile hash
Dedupe operator will emit a `canonical_session_id` and `discarded_ids` list (kept only in internal audit store)
Late-arrival merge: compute `dedupe_confidence` based on time_delta, token_overlap_ratio, and signature_match_score
Back-pressure: keep in-memory state limited by sharding on customer_id and use RocksDB incremental compaction
For Dedicated tenants with strict isolation, allow a per-tenant dedupe policy toggle to disable cross-route merges
Plan rollout as canary on `billing-read-only` for 3 tenants for two billing cycles before global enabling

runbook_notes: How to disable dedupe for a tenant: toggle `tenant.dedupe_policy.enabled=false` in envoy-config and restart shipper
If canonical_session_id spikes: run `backfill/duplicate-audit` job to reconcile and notify billing team
Monitoring: track dedupe_rate, collision_count, and dedupe_confidence distribution; alert on dedupe_rate <0.5 or collision_count > 1000/hour
